statement: Lambda's on-demand catalogue lists only NVIDIA parts (B200, H100, A100, GH200) with no H200 and no AMD MI300X or MI355X instances.
why: A major GPU cloud offering no AMD accelerator instances is a visible read on how little alternative-supply capacity is reaching rentable inventory.

impact.mechanism: Absence of AMD instances at a significant neocloud indicates alternative accelerator supply is not displacing NVIDIA in rentable capacity, sustaining concentration of demand on the incumbent merchant-GPU vendor.

evidence.excerpt: No H200 or AMD MI300X/MI355X instances appear in the pricing tables.

confidence.basis: Direct observation of one vendor's public catalogue; single provider, secondary source, and absence from a page is weaker than a stated policy.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: Lambda (lambda.ai), RunPod (runpod.io)
